findings_or_gaps: Medium: the latest amendment is incomplete. Although the snapshot model contains chloride and effective nitrite hazard, the dedicated chemistry surfaces still do not expose them. crates/tank_api/src/handlers/snapshot.rs:32-79 drops both fields from /chemistry, and crates/tank_tui/src/screens/chemistry.rs:22-65 never renders them, so chloride-adjusted hazard is still not visible on the API/TUI chemistry screen between event firings.

Coverage gap: current tests exercise snapshot serialization, tracing, events, and the salt-treatment scenario, but there is no regression test asserting that /chemistry or the TUI chemistry screen surfaces the new chloride/effective-hazard fields, which is why the omission slipped through.
follow_up_or_amendments: Add chloride_mg_per_l and effective_nitrite_hazard_mg_per_l to crates/tank_api/src/handlers/snapshot.rs::chemistry_response_json and extend chemistry_field_semantics_json with explicit descriptions/units for both fields.
Update crates/tank_tui/src/screens/chemistry.rs to render chloride and effective nitrite hazard on the Chemistry screen so the values are visible between event emissions.

Add regression coverage for both surfaces: an API handler test that asserts /chemistry includes the new fields, and a TUI screen test or equivalent render assertion that verifies the Chemistry screen shows them.
